helpful: The provisioned petition text was the decisive input: the procedural-history and reasons sections carried the Shilling stay, the panel lineup, and the mandate-stay posture, none of which the snapshot's single docket entry shows.
The band table's bracketed reached figures with matching salience_version made the arrival anchor unambiguous.
gaps: fedcourts query has no free-text/caption search, and the citation column is nearly empty (159 of ~590k scotus rows), so there is no practical way to pull doctrinally similar priors for a subject-matter read; a caption or QP-text similarity filter would help.
Each citation query cost ~1300 ranged GETs / ~350MB to return zero rows; a coverage pre-check or cheaper index probe would save that.
No forward-hazard cut for relists (buckets are terminal counts), so the relist-increment number from a zero-distribution state is shape-reading rather than a lookup.
notes: Arrival-moment federal-band cell; anchored on the pooled federal reached floor (~71%, 2017-2025) and adjusted up on petition-specific signals.
